critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper deck hump geometry along the longitudinal axis of the fuselage. Increase the length from its current abrupt termination to approximately 60% of the total fuselage length, ensuring it aligns with the reference's substantial profile. Simultaneously, apply a fillet or bevel at the leading edge transition to smooth the sharp angle between the main deck and the hump, creating a more integrated curve.

discrepancies.observed: The hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck extends significantly further back along the fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The hump is a low, rounded protrusion.
discrepancies.reference: The hump has a distinct vertical rise and more pronounced volume.

discrepancies.observed: The transition from the main deck to the hump is sharp.
discrepancies.reference: The transition is smooth and integrated into the fuselage curve.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears very narrow relative to the lower fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wider, more substantial profile.
